name: oumi-platform
description: Work in your Oumi projects as the signed-in user: inspect resources, prepare datasets, and run training, evaluation, and deployment jobs you approve.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Oumi account to inspect projects, datasets, models, evaluations, deployments, and operations; upload and shape datasets; set up evaluators and training recipes; and run training, evaluation, deployment, and synthesis jobs you explicitly approve, all with your existing Oumi permissions.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the datasets in my Oumi project.
Show the recent evaluations in my project and compare their scores.
Fine-tune a model on one of my datasets and track the training operation.
